keyFindings.description: Cleanup, the named fast-follow (no behaviour change). One rule, the earliest spelling with the greatest read-back depth, is written out step by step in two places, each with a proof comment. A spelling is rewritten up to 3 times and parsed up to 6 times. altReadsBack returns two bools that depend on each other.
Wording: permanent comments call the writer before this change "main", which names this code after the merge. strikethrough_test.go:61 still says "kind" where the code means runGroup.

roundOneFindings: Both byte-stability findings are fixed in 1a5c2dc2. Reviewer probe (Parse+Render at main 448a4100 and at 1a5c2dc2): ![**a*_](u), ![*a**_](u), ![_**a*](u), ![_*a**](u), the same alt text in a heading, and `x ~~\_\_\*\*é\_b~~**\ y [...]` are byte-identical at both. The deep review's differential --base 448a41003a17 over tgt+adv+in-repo (50,085 documents): every GATE line 0 except misreads 1 (t-27479). Over two new adversarial corpora (40,085): regressions, churn, engine-tree churn and lost fixed points 0, misreads 248. Each misread is an older non-delimiter difference (linkify, mailto, entity without `;`, `<?>`) in a document main refused only because of its tilde writer. The PR body's risk lines record this class.
